name: GoPro
author: Jalil Wahdatehagh
description: Copy photos and video off a USB-connected GoPro from the Omarchy bar. Browse the card by day with thumbnails, copy in the background with progress and an ETA, and clear the card once every file is verified on disk.

barWidget.description: Browse a connected GoPro by day and copy its media to disk in the background.

schema.label: Where to copy media
schema.description: The plugin creates day folders (YYYY-MM-DD) inside it. Leave empty for ~/Pictures/GoPro.

schema.label: Hide the icon when no camera is connected
Notify when a camera is plugged in
schema.description: Says how much is waiting. It copies nothing until you ask.
